basisOfRecord.quote: This study was conducted in an environmental gradient of mining activities in 24 streams in the eastern Amazon.
we sampled 1 l of water sample from each stream, obtained and preserved following the APHA (2005) protocols, to be analyzed in the laboratory.

The matrix of functional traits of Ephemeroptera genera was assembled from qualitative and binary traits based on the literature, and quantitative traits were measured in the laboratory on at least two individuals from each genus and from each stream (Table S2).

From the total of 27 genera used for functional and beta functional diversity analysis, two individuals per genus were randomly selected according to their last larval stage ("pharate nymph") before becoming adults, representing a total of 2,153 individuals included in functional analysis (Table S3).
